extracted.intended_audience: members, staff, committee chairs, and researchers participating in the Administrative Conference of the United States recommendation process
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for developing, approving, and implementing formal recommendations within the Administrative Conference of the United States via its Project Process. Covers the sequence of steps from idea generation through adoption and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Administrative Conference Project Process
rubrics_metrics.description: The Conference’s research and the resulting recommendations are conducted through the Administrative Conference Project Process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All recommendation work should follow the Project Process framework (i.e., research leading to a committee recommendation and Council/Conference consideration).

rubrics_metrics.name: Gather and select ideas for a project
rubrics_metrics.description: Gathering and selecting ideas for a project
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start by collecting potential topics and selecting which ideas will become formal projects to develop into recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obtain Council approval
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected project ideas must be presented to and approved by the Conference Council before proceeding to researcher selection and study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select a researcher
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and appoint a researcher (or research team) responsible for producing the report that will inform committee deliberations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee consideration of the researcher’s report
rubrics_metrics.description: Having the researcher’s report considered by a committee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The researcher’s findings are reviewed by the assigned Conference committee, which uses the report as the evidentiary basis for recommendation drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee formulates a recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: Having the selected committee formulate a recommendation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The committee synthesizes the research and deliberations into a formal recommendation document for further consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council and full Conference consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Having a committee’s recommendation considered by the Council and then the full Conference membership
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations advance from committee to Council review and then to the plenary Conference membership for debate and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption by voting members at semi-annual plenary sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations are adopted by the voting members of the Conference at semi-annual plenary sessions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final adoption requires a vote of the Conference’s voting membership during one of the semi-annual plenary meetings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After adoption, follow-up actions occur to promote, disseminate, and implement the recommendation (e.g., outreach, monitoring, or assistance with uptake).
